notes.title: Seasonal Update + Future of MacOS version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'd like to formally announce the very first seasonal update of Mr. Sanna Clozz. The first thing you may notice is that the macOS version of the game is no longer available. This is only temporary and it WILL be back very soon! For reasons beyond my control, I could not publish the latest build through Apple's notary service. That being said, let's talk about the updates that are available for our Windows users.

-Major glitch was fixed in the 'Toyshop Suites' stage regarding elevator usage
-Cutscene glitch in which traveling by sleigh failed to drop the player off
-Issues with portal to hub world transitions have been fixed
-Boss fight in the 'Sugar Avenue' stage has been heavily optimized
-Stages that include grass and other nature details have been heavily optimized
-'Lightspeed Freeway' speed glitch has been fixed
-Special moves have been made more compact and take up less space on the screen
-'Style' options added in the special moves menu (Ability to swap skins outside of the hub world)

notes.title: Portal Glitch Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’m pushing another update to the game to fix a portal crossing issue. This time there were three alternative solutions added. Number one is an improved collision script. This will increase the chances of touching the portal working.

If somehow simply colliding with the portal fails, the second alternative is this: I have added in a new return to hub world action button. You can press this while near a portal that leads to back to the hub world. 

https://i.imgur.com/FCK7AQ3.png

Finally, if the button somehow does not work as well, you can quit the current level and reload your progress. Worlds are now marked as complete as soon as you defeat the major boss fight in that world.

UPDATE 12/27:
Post-World error patched. Can attack after returning back to worlds.

notes.title: MacOS Version Patch
notes.notes:
After a rocky start, the macOS version of Mr. Sanna Clozz is now available and working on Intel and Silicon architectures. Thank you for being patient and enjoy the game!

I will also be hosting a giveaway on Christmas Eve! Stay tuned for more information and follow my developer account @omagofficial
